text:
Maria G.: Late receipt — corporate card Uber + dinner last night, missing itemized receipt in Ramp. Charge shows 'UBER TRIP $42.87' on 03/10. I scanned the emailed receipt just now. Do I need manager sign-off or is there a lost-receipt exception?

Alan B.: Hey @Maria G. can you attach the photo here? Also which card was used (last4)?

Maria G.: Attached: IMG_20250310_uber.jpg (screenshot of trip email). Card last4: 1234.

expense-bot: Receipt uploaded to Ramp — pending match. (receipt id: RMP-55893)

Jordan F. (Finance): Thanks @Maria. Two things: we need either an itemized receipt showing merchant and amount, or manager approval for a lost/partial receipt. Since you have a photo of the Uber receipt, that should cover the ride. For the dinner, we need the restaurant itemized receipt for tax/accounting. If you don't have it, manager approval + attendee list + business purpose is acceptable for one-off exceptions (policy: up to $150).

Maria G.: I also attached the dinner receipt: IMG_20250310_dinner.pdf. Total $98.54. The corporate card shows the full $98.54. I had water and shared dessert that was personal — how do I split this?

Sam L. (manager): I confirm this was a business dinner with ACME folks. I approve the business portion. Attendees: Maria G., Sam L., Kevin R. Business purpose: scoping call / kickoff.

Jordan F. (Finance): Great — @Maria please upload both receipts to Ramp and add the following note in the expense comment exactly (helps audit):
```
Business purpose: ACME kickoff meeting
Attendees: Maria G., Sam L., Kevin R.
Split: Dinner 66% business / 34% personal (dessert)
Manager approval: Sam L. (auth)
```

Maria G.: Done. Uploaded both files and added the note. Also attached a screenshot of the Uber trip details from the app in case Ramp flags the match.

Jordan F. (Finance): Thanks — I'll mark as approved once Ramp shows manager approval. If Ramp asks for a clearer Uber proof, grab the trip email (fare breakdown) or a wallet screenshot with trip id.

expense-bot: Expense #EXP-2025-4892 created and moved to 'Awaiting Finance Review'.

Elaine T.: Quick Q — do we need VAT reclaim forms for EU meals? This was US so no VAT needed.

Jordan F. (Finance): Correct, US meal. No VAT paperwork. All set from finance side; will finalize after Ramp processes manager approval. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
